summary: cmux's README gives no performance numbers; it describes the app as having 'Fast startup, low memory' (README.md:94). The repository contains engineering benchmarks with committed raw data and documented commands: browser-REPL snapshot time and output size (cards-50k 3,297 → 427 ms at p50, matching tests/browser-parity/perf/results/before-cmux.json and after-cmux.json), cloud-VM startup latency, and event-log write batching. All are before/after or competitor comparisons run on developer machines with small samples; the cloud benchmarks need Freestyle provider credentials, and the cards-200k 'over 6 min' baseline is recorded as a note ('did not finish') in before-cmux-dev.json rather than as a timing.
result_focus_note: manual classification of published_results: outcome = does the tool do its job; engineering = speed of the software itself

corrections: Summary said the cards-200k 'over 6 min' baseline is not in the data files; it is recorded as a note without a timing at tests/browser-parity/perf/results/before-cmux-dev.json:2698
Summary said the benchmarks ran 'on one machine'; the browser result files record two hosts (mac.lan; lawrences-MacBook-Pro-2.local for before-cmux-dev.json and ref-chrome.json)
